alex: quick heads-up — spun up a canary with a phase-aware scheduler (separate prefill/decode queues) on cluster-qa.
alex: config used: `phase_split=true; prefill_budget=4; decode_budget=20; kv_prelock=true`
maya: nice, any perf numbers yet?
alex: short run w/ gpt-3x-small-ish model: p50 decode latency down ~12%, p95 down ~6%, but prefill p95 increased ~18% on cold starts
ben: hmm did you enable kernel pinning? might push prefill to a slow kernel when batch sizes jump
alex: yes — runtime chose `fp16_fused_v2` for decode and fell back to `matmul_generic` for prefill when seq_len > 128
maria: that kernel switch rings alarm bells. do we have profiler traces? can you paste flamegraph?
alex: flamegraph snippet pasted: ```
# flamegraph snippet
prefill: majority in `matmul_generic` @ 62%
decode: `fused_attention_v2` @ 45%, `kv_copy` @ 18%
```
kevin: KV behavior looks suspect — `kv_copy` spikes during prefill when cache misses. batching policy may be aggregating too many prefixes into a single prefill batch
maya: what about queue policy? are prefill requests allowed to steal tokens from decode queue?
alex: current policy: `global_token_budget=64k`, per-phase targets are proportional to active_requests. Prefill sometimes starves decode because prefill requests have longer avg_seq_len
ben: suggestion: add explicit phase_priority for low-latency decode; cap prefill batch by `token_budget_per_batch`
alex: implemented a local change: `phase_priority=decode>prefill`, `max_prefill_tokens=1024`, `allow_prefill_when_decode_idle=true`
alex: rerun on canary — early metric: p95 decode improved an additional ~8%, prefill p95 back to +4% (much better trade-off)
maria: nice. any regressions elsewhere? throughput drop?
alex: throughput stable; small bump in GPU mem pressure, KV cache eviction rate up ~3%
kevin: eviction increase could explain cold-start prefill slowness. maybe tune `kv_prelock` to pre-allocate expected cache slots based on sequence buckets
maya: also check kernel selection heuristic: add hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping when `avg_seq_length` hovers around boundary
ben: agree — `kernel_switch_threshold=0.15` (15% change) looks reasonable, and add a 2s debounce on kernel switch decisions
alex: trying kernel hysteresis + phase_priority; next run scheduled in ~30m, will post results
ci-bot: deploy started for canary group `eng-runtime-canary-2` at 1742309999 :rocket:
maria: thx. if next run looks good, we can promote patch to dedicated by EOD
maya: also add unit tests for queue budget calc, we had a bug there last quarter that silently allowed negative budgets
ben: noted, i'll open a PR for tests and a small sim harness to fuzz token budgets across workloads
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
